candidates.name: remittance-update
candidates.what_it_holds: Reconstructed World Bank/KNOMAD bilateral remittance matrix extended through 2025 (KNOMAD's official matrix stops at 2021). data/output/ has bilateral_matrix_2000_2025.parquet + .csv (corridor-level flows, country pairs), country_received_2000_2025.csv, country_sent_2000_2025.csv, yearly_summary_2000_2025.csv, plus a validation comparison to the official 2021 matrix (0.963 correlation, recovers 93.3% of total flows). Built from UN DESA International Migrant Stock (2020/2024 revisions) + World Bank WDI GNI-per-capita and remittance inflow/outflow totals via WDI API; gaps filled by interpolation/extrapolation capped at +/-20% CAGR, normalized to reported country totals. ~9.3K bilateral cells in 2024 vs ~12.3K earlier years (fewer migrant-stock pairs in later years). Updated 15 days ago (active). Global country coverage, annual 2000-2025.
candidates.why_useful: Fills numbered gap #6 (consumer spend / cross-border capacity proxy): remittance flows are a standard proxy for diaspora travel and cross-border consumer strength, and this is a maintained, methodologically transparent, point-in-time-labeled (annual vintage) global bilateral series extending past the official KNOMAD 2021 cutoff into 2025 — useful as a regional (LatAm/APAC/EMEA) demand-strength cross-check for ABNB's regional nights/ADR splits.
candidates.size_hint: ~9-12K bilateral cells/year x 25 years, parquet + csv

candidates.name: EconomicTracker
candidates.what_it_holds: Official Opportunity Insights Economic Tracker (tracktherecovery.org) data repo, 341 stars, updated 2 days ago. Aggregated, de-identified credit/debit card spending indices by county, industry (including Accommodation & Food Services, Arts/Entertainment/Recreation, Transportation/Transit affinity categories), and income group, sourced from card processors (Affinity Solutions) and payroll firms (Earnin, Paychex); daily/weekly frequency from Jan 2020. Includes a Data Dictionary and Data Documentation in-repo plus a revisions log.
candidates.why_useful: Directly named in CONTEXT.md gap #6 ("Opportunity Insights Economic Tracker card spend") as a HIGH-value target; confirms the data is on GitHub with committed CSVs at county/industry granularity including travel-adjacent spend categories (accommodation, recreation, transit) that could proxy US regional travel/leisure demand strength feeding ABNB North America nights.
candidates.license: Free to use with citation; Opportunity Insights states it will never sell/monetize data
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: Not currently held per CONTEXT.md; explicitly listed as a gap-6 target, not yet acquired

notes:
Dead ends: WebSearch (the WebSearch tool) reported its session-wide budget (200/200) was already exhausted before this scout ran any query — could not use it at all. DuckDuckGo HTML search (html.duckduckgo.com/html/) returned a bot-check CAPTCHA page for every query, unusable. Bing (bing.com/search) accepted queries but silently ignored the site:github.com filter and returned generic/unrelated web results (dictionary definitions, YouTube, unrelated brands) for every query tried — not usable for this modality. Fell back successfully to two channels: (1) `gh search repos` via the GitHub CLI, which worked intermittently but hit HTTP 403 'API rate limit exceeded for user ID 80365855' repeatedly (recovered after a pause without an explicit sleep, since sleep/Start-Sleep standalone calls are blocked in this environment) and (2) directly fetching github.com/search?q=...&type=repositories via WebFetch, which worked well most of the time but occasionally 429'd (Adyen, IMF BOP, tourism-satellite-account, ONS card-spending queries all hit 429 and were not retried given budget). 

Substantive finding: this theme is genuinely sparse on GitHub. Mastercard SpendingPulse, Visa merchant spending indices, Stripe/Adyen economic indexes, and true 'tourism receipts from balance of payments' datasets essentially do not exist as committed GitHub datasets — searches for these exact concepts returned zero relevant repos (mostly crypto/blockchain 'remittance app' noise, or 0 results). The two closest hits are old Mastercard developer-API reference-implementation scaffolds (no data, defunct-looking) and n8n's community node wrapping the same API (method only, needs a paid/gated Mastercard developer key so likely out of scope per 'never use paid API keys'). The productive adjacent finds were: (a) a well-documented, actively maintained (updated 15 days ago) reconstructed World Bank/KNOMAD bilateral remittance matrix extending to 2025, which is the best proxy this scout found for 'cross-border money-flow strength by country pair'; (b) confirming the Opportunity Insights Economic Tracker (explicitly named in CONTEXT.md gap #6) is live on GitHub with committed county/industry card-spend CSVs including travel-adjacent categories; (c) two UNWTO tourism-statistics GitHub mirrors with committed CSV/xlsx files (1995-2022 and 1995-2030) that touch on tourism receipts/BOP framing even if not a pure payments-processor index. Recommend a future scout try: national central-bank open-data APIs (Norges Bank, Banco de Portugal, Banco de España) for card-payment statistics — none surfaced any GitHub client/mirror in this pass, but Bing's failure to honor site: filters means this was not conclusively ruled out; also worth trying `gh api` GraphQL search directly (bypassing the search-repos REST endpoint that hit 403) if another scout has more budget.
